subject.title: fix(xai): apply request policy to video generation requests

question: Should xAI video polling and generated-video downloads become default-deny for private-network destinations, requiring explicit `models.providers.xai.request.allowPrivateNetwork: true` even though current behavior fetches those URLs unguarded?
rationale: The code and proof establish the behavior precisely, but choosing between preserving the shipped permissive path and enforcing the safer default is a compatibility and SSRF-policy decision that automation should not make.

options.title: Accept Default-Deny
options.body: Adopt guarded polling and downloads with explicit private-network opt-in, retaining the PR’s header-isolation and transport tests.

options.title: Preserve Configured-Origin Compatibility
options.body: Use the shared configured-origin trust contract or another narrow compatibility rule while still guarding provider-returned cross-origin media URLs.

options.title: Pause The Change
options.body: Keep current behavior until xAI URL-origin guarantees and upgrade expectations are documented with live provider evidence.

recommendation.title: Accept Default-Deny
recommendation.body: Adopt guarded polling and downloads with explicit private-network opt-in, retaining the PR’s header-isolation and transport tests.

likelyOwner.reason: KateWilkins is the strongest available xAI-specific routing candidate, while provider-transport reviewers can confirm the shared security contract.
